identification: Two H. McHugh Tasmania (Launceston) art pottery vases, 1930s. Larger: baluster/ovoid vase, rolled rim, streaked brown, amber-yellow and cobalt blue drip glaze, approx 12-14cm (est. from photo). Smaller: squat bulbous vase with flared neck, green, amber and brown drip glaze, approx 9-10cm. The chip is a glaze/body flake on the RIM of the SMALL green vase (front left of neck rim); the larger vase also shows small glaze nibbles at the foot rim edge in the base photo.
